A1.justification: Both PDFs describe MetaSlot, with matching core methods and experiments. The text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and support comparison, including identification of relocated and combined material.

before.justification: v1 reports original object-discovery and set-prediction experiments, component ablations, training curves, and qualitative prototype analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these empirical results and adds sensitivity experiments, component controls, and comparisons with additional methods in Appendices D and E.

M1.justification: Section 2 and Algorithm 1 retain the same two-stage aggregation, prototype quantization, duplicate masking, noise schedule, gradient truncation, and codebook updates. The added ablations test variants of this unchanged method; proposed future extensions are not implemented changes.

E1.justification: Appendix E adds MOVi-C video object discovery. ClevrTex, COCO, VOC, and HQ-YTVIS coverage is retained, as are the existing object-discovery and set-prediction tasks.

E2.justification: v2 substantially extends the evaluated comparator set: SlotContrast on MOVi-C, AdaSlot alongside BO-QSA on COCO, and SysBinder and NLoTM on COCO and ClevrTex. AdaSlot was discussed but not experimentally compared in v1. Existing comparisons remain.

E3.justification: New evaluation designs include codebook-size and slot-count sweeps, a six-iteration BO-QSA control, MOVi-C evaluation with 24-frame samples, batch size 8 and 20,000 training steps, and a ViT-B/16 COCO comparison using 40,000 steps. These supplement the unchanged original settings; the new SlotContrast and AdaSlot comparisons explicitly use unequal training budgets.

E4.justification: Appendix D adds tests of codebook size, slot count, prototype guidance, dead-prototype reactivation, and whether extra attention iterations explain performance. These substantially extend v1's noise and masking ablations, which remain unchanged. Table 8 labels the prose-described reactivation ablation 'w/o prune,' leaving its precise configuration unclear.

E5.justification: Both versions state that results are averaged over three random seeds, and uncertainty entries in Tables 1, 2, 4, and 5 are unchanged. The added appendix tables introduce no new run-count statement, confidence interval, significance test, or uncertainty-estimation method.

E6.justification: Tables 1–5 retain their numerical results, while Tables 6–13 add sensitivity, ablation, and comparator results. MOVi-C reports MetaSlot at 63.9 FG-ARI and 35.0 mBO versus SlotContrast at 62.4 and 30.6 under unequal budgets. New comparisons also expose metric tradeoffs: NLoTM has higher COCO ARI than MetaSlot, and SysBinder has higher ClevrTex FG-ARI.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations 1–11 are unchanged. Added mechanism discussion and philosophical motivation introduce no new formal assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introductory contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about dynamic slot allocation, semantic prototype initialization, progressive noise, and broad applicability. Additional experiments support these existing claims without redefining the central contribution.

C2.justification: v2 adds interpretations of codebook sensitivity, slot-count effects, attribute-level quantization, and possible integration with SlotContrast. Section 6 adds a future direction using second-stage slots to supervise first-stage aggregation. It retains the translation, compositional, and OOD limitations but drops v1's explicit limited-theoretical-understanding caveat and replaces the untested-codebook concern with experiments.

D1.justification: The declared code location changes from an anonymous repository to GitHub. v2 supplies backbone, frame-count, batch-size, and training-budget information for the added comparisons. The original implementation and pretraining details are retained, moving from Appendix D to Appendix C.

R1.justification: All 75 original references are retained, with three additions covering SysBinder, NLoTM, and SlotContrast. Section 3 and Appendix E extend positioning against attribute-level quantization and temporal contrastive learning, while preserving the original research framing.

P1.justification: Most existing prose is retained. v2 rewrites and moves the limitations into Section 6, reorganizes the appendices, adds acknowledgments and author-contact information, and expands cross-references. It also corrects 'mean boundary overlap' to 'mean best overlap' without changing the metric used.

P2.justification: The appendix gains substantial new tabular displays for sensitivity, ablations, and comparisons in Tables 6–13; Tables 9 and 10 duplicate the same MOVi-C comparison. v1's two full-page VOC visualization figures are combined into one side-by-side Figure 5 with the examples retained. Table 5 and Figure 4 are relocated, while the main diagrams remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The added sensitivity tests address v1's acknowledged codebook-size gap, while the iteration control and relevant new baselines improve empirical scrutiny of the unchanged method. The gain is limited by unequal budgets in added comparisons, absent uncertainty for small new ablation differences, and the mismatch between Table 8's 'w/o prune' label and its reactivation description. These additions provide useful support without fully resolving the evidential limitations.
